svg.aria-label: Standup Chief of Staff: Voice briefings for developers on Alexa+. Turns pull requests, failing CI and stale reviews into a 30-second spoken briefing, then acts on voice commands. Built for the Amazon Developer Hackathon. Tests: 33 passing. Built with: TypeScript, MCP, Amazon Bedrock.
